newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Hills says too early for M2 judgment.
newsitem.headline: Hills says too early for M2 judgment.

text.p: Tollroad operator Hills Motorway Group, responding to an Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) query, said on Wednesday that it was too early to make a judgment about the success of its M2 motorway in Sydney.
Hills released data on Tuesday showing average daily traffic in June of 39,801 vehicles. June was the motorway's first full month of operation.

"The company notes that as the motorway has been in operation for less than two months it is too early to draw any conclusions as to the Motorway's future operating performance and it would be inappropriate to do so," Hills said in its response to an ASX query. It also said in the response that it was in compliance with continuous disclosure rules.
The 39,801 compares with a forecast of average daily traffic of 72,000 by the end of 1998.
